rulingTitle: The exemption still checks only working-tree text, so a setup-time mode or index change to the ledger can pass; moreover, setup failure or a cost stop after advice bypasses ledgerStep and leaves the tracked append dirty.

action.reason: Hold. Setup can change the ledger’s file mode or staged contents without failing the in-place cleanliness check. A setup failure or cost stop can also leave the tracked append dirty.

rationale: inPlaceDirty exempts the ledger path when its working-tree text matches advisorLedger.after; it does not check the mode or index state. Advice runs before setup, but persistence depends on reaching ledgerStep. Preserve the verified append before setup and restore the unconditional clean-tree check.

rulingTitle: On commit failure, rollback rewrites the authoritative in-place ledger to its pre-advice contents, deleting the decision. Unlike a separate checkout, there is no main-checkout copy to carry on retry.

action.reason: Hold. A failed Git add or commit can erase the only uncommitted copy of the advisor decision.

rationale: commitInPlaceAppend calls restore with appended.before. That rewrites the authoritative ledger or deletes it if it was previously absent. Preserve the append on failure and report it as pending; if HEAD already contains it, treat it as persisted rather than restoring stale text.

rulingTitle: Any difference between the two ledger snapshots is classified as an advisor append. A concurrent truncation or replacement during routing can therefore be committed as a valid decision-ledger update.

action.reason: Hold. A truncated or replaced ledger can be committed as an advisor append, removing earlier decisions from the current ledger.

rationale: withChainRulings accepts any non-null after snapshot unequal to before, and readLedgerText maps every read error to null. The in-place commit checks only that the file still matches after. Distinguish a missing file from a failed read and require the new text to strictly extend the known prior contents before accepting it.
